Do you have any questions about the charges made?
Open the list of your past EasyRide journeys in SBB Mobile and choose the relevant travel day. Then select the option 'Report a problem with this journey' and send us your question. We will look into it and get back to you promptly. You can find the order overview in your account under ‘Orders’.

Do you have a general question or want to provide feedback on EasyRide?
In the app, tap on the ‘Profile’ tab, continue with tapping on ‘Help & contact’ and then on ‘FAQ and contact’. This takes you to the SBB Help & Contact area. Enter your desired search term in the search tool and you’ll see the answers to the most frequently asked questions.
